title: Zakhm e akbar pe laila rida daal do
body:
Zakhm e akbar pe laila rida daal do
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Akbar haaye Akbar..(3)
<<MINI>>
Keh rahe the ye roro ke sarwar
zakhm e Akbar pe Laila ridaa daaldo
<<DIVIDER>>
Mera farzand Hai khoon mein tarr..(2)
<<MINI>>
zakhm e Akbar pe Laila ridaa daaldo
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Zakhm se is qadar khoo'n bahaa hai
khoon e akbar se tarr karbala hai
Naiza e zulm ki loriyo se
Laadla Mera soyaa huwa hai
Koi isko jagaade na aakar
<<MINI>>
zakhm e Akbar pe Laila ridaa daaldo
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Haath me khoo'n ki mehndi lagaalo
Bass tasawwur me doolha banaalo
Tumne maanii hai jo zindagi bhar
Mannate aaj saari badhaalo
Gurbato ka ye sehra sajaakar
<<MINI>>
zakhm e Akbar pe Laila ridaa daaldo
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Meri behno ko kab ye pataa Hai
Wo samajhtii Hai ye sorahaa Hai
Sard Hai jism saakit Hai nabzein
Mera kadiyal jawaa marchukaa Hai
Haath seene se iskaa hataakar
<<MINI>>
zakhm e Akbar pe Laila ridaa daaldo
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Ghum ki kaalii ghataa chaa rahii Hai
Mujhko ye baat tadpaa rahii Hai
Pardaa saidaaniyo ka luteyga
Shaam e gurbat qareeb aarahii Hai Phir mayassar kahaa hogi chaadar
<<MINI>>
zakhm e Akbar pe Laila ridaa daaldo
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Khaak me milgaya hai wo baano
Jisko mitti bhi lagne na dii ho
Kitne naazo se paala tha usne
zakhm jaldii se bibi chupaado
Binte zehra na dekhe ye manzar
<<MINI>>
zakhm e Akbar pe Laila ridaa daaldo
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Haaye meri sakina ki gurbat
Kaise dekhegi bhai ki mayyat
Do janaaze na uth'tenge mujhse
Wo to zindaan kii hai amaanat
Marna jaaye kahii Meri dukhtarr
<<MINI>>
zakhm e Akbar pe Laila ridaa daaldo
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Usko ye kehke dena dilaasa
Tuu ne dekha na bhai ka laasha
Teri jaanib se maadar ne leykin
Bekafan ko kafan dediyaa Tha
Naam beemaar sughra ka leykar
<<MINI>>
zakhm e Akbar pe Laila ridaa daaldo
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Aye hilaal ek mehshar bapaa tha
Khaima e shaah maatam kadaa tha
Ashq aankho se paiham rawaa the
Aal e Ahmad me shor e bukaa tha
Jab ye kehte the sibt e payambar
<<MINI>>
zakhm e Akbar pe Laila ridaa daaldo
Keh rahe the ye roro ke sarwar
